correctness.rationale: Reconstructed all vertices ±w_S via active box/difference constraints (strict δ domain), symmetry reduction to H=hh^T and J=I-H, John facet constraints (u+(d-1)v)/d<=1 and 2v<=δ². For Löwner, vertex orbit projections are A_k=d(1-δ+δk/d)^2 and B_k=δ²k(d-k)/d. Dominance of k<ceil(d/2) reduces constraints; concavity of log t+(d-1)log s gives unique optimum and strict s>t. As function of k, A_k t+B_k s is a strictly concave quadratic, so 1 or 2 adjacent maximizers; stationary KKT yields exact candidate enumeration. Checked initial τ_d condition through next-layer inequality and δ>=d-√d as necessary/sufficient pole contact. Independently enumerated KKT rational solutions/contact layers and d*t<1 for d>=4 in 120 cases d=2..21 and six rational δ; original finite verifier reports 348 cases d=2..30. All-d proof rests on inequalities, not finite cases.
residual_risks: Finite candidate formula rather than one global radical expression; strict endpoints δ=0,2 excluded

value.rationale: The same natural one-parameter alcoved polytope has a nontrivial two-eigenvalue extremal ellipsoid with exact parity-dependent contact transition and high-dimensional pole avoidance, not predictable from volume or minimum-radius sphere. Finite KKT enumeration gives a reproducible exact closed determination for every d and δ without hidden numerical optimization.
residual_risks: Higher contact thresholds encoded by finite candidates, not a single compact elementary phase diagram

final_claim: For d>=2 and 0<δ<2, the normalized isocanted cube has John shape uH+vJ with v=min(1,δ²/2),u=d-(d-1)v; its unique Löwner inverse shape tH+sJ is determined by exact finite KKT candidates, its contact vertices occupy one or two consecutive Hamming layers, with parity-sensitive first transition τ_d; for d>=4 diagonal Euclidean-radius poles are strictly inside the Löwner ellipsoid.
